newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sees Deutsche stake in 1998.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sees Deutsche stake in 1998.

text.p: A France Telecom official said that it was likely the company would take cross shareholdings of some 10 percent with Deutsche Telekom in 1998.
"It has always been the plan to exchange stakes to cement our alliance," an official said. "That does not need to be a big stake, say 10 percent," he added.

"But instead of the two governments deciding what the value of the stake should be, we are both going to the market and in a year's time we will see what the market says is the value of the stake," he said.
The official, who declined to be indentified, said that one of the two operators would then have to pay the difference in share values.
